name: Holy Water
operation_language: Authoring intent only; not registered engine syntax.

rules.text: With the Attack action, replace one attack by throwing a flask at a visible creature within 20 feet. Dexterity save DC 8 + your Dexterity modifier + Proficiency Bonus; failure deals 2d8 Radiant damage if target is Fiend or Undead.

authored_operations: With the Attack action, replace one attack by throwing a flask at a visible creature within 20 feet. Dexterity save DC 8 + your Dexterity modifier + Proficiency Bonus; failure deals 2d8 Radiant damage if target is Fiend or Undead.

definition.name: Holy Water (Flask, 25 GP)
definition.description: A flask of Holy Water worth 25 GP. Consumed when casting Protection from Evil and Good.

unsupported_behavior.requirement: Holy Water replaces one Attack-action attack and consumes one flask; keep remaining attacks, sight/range, Dexterity DC and Fiend/Undead gate. Seed effect arrays do not certify support.
